events.event: Apple reported fiscal Q4 results and guided a December-quarter gross margin of 45-46% because AI-driven memory chip shortages are raising component costs.
events.key_numbers: Revenue US$114.48 billion (consensus US$113.39 billion) · gross margin guidance 45-46% vs 47.9% · iPhone sales US$57.58 billion · China sales US$17.54 billion vs US$18.58 billion est. · iPhone 17 price raised US$100 · purchase commitments up US$33 billion · shares fell as much as 4%
events.why_it_matters: Memory costs are pushing up iPhone and laptop prices, and Apple says they stay high into next year.

events.event: NTT Data told Reuters it will sharply increase data center investment in Indonesia over the next 2-3 years while opening a 12 MW annex in Jakarta.
events.key_numbers: 12 MW Jakarta annex · US$500 million (about Rp9 trillion) invested since 2015 · Indonesia data center market US$2.81 billion in 2025 to US$6.08 billion by 2031 (Research and Markets)
events.why_it_matters: Foreign money is rushing into Indonesian data centres while power, water and land competition draws local opposition elsewhere.

events.event: A cyberattack on travel-booking provider Amadeus exposed passenger records at several Asian airlines including Malaysia Airlines, Cathay Pacific and Japan Airlines.
events.key_numbers: Cathay Pacific about 53,000 booking records · Japan Airlines about 92,000 passenger records · Malaysia Airlines data Aug 2023-Sep 2026 · global total undisclosed
events.why_it_matters: Booking data leaks fuel phishing; Indonesians flying these airlines should be wary of messages asking for details.

events.event: WIRED investigation found more than 400 apps and domains posing as harmless AI apps that hide deepfake sexual-image tools, evading app store review via external servers.
events.key_numbers: 400+ apps/domains · 27 apps on Google Play with 350,000+ downloads (Sep 2026) · Apple removed 19 apps · Apple guideline update 16 Oct 2026
events.why_it_matters: Innocent-looking photo apps on the Play Store can secretly send you to deepfake porn tools.

events.event: CNBC Indonesia explained the LIMS lawful-interception system at the centre of the illegal wiretapping case in which Bareskrim named three senior police officers as suspects.
events.key_numbers: 3 suspects (initials LSP, ASN, EHS) · 1 police witness · KUHP Art. 258 max 10 years · also KUHP Art. 332 and ITE Law Art. 32(1) · Bareskrim press conference 3 Nov 2026
events.why_it_matters: Explains the telecom system that let numbers be tapped without a legal order, a tech angle on the biggest political story.
events.spreading_evidence: Three of the top 7 CNBC Tech headlines on 4 Nov are about wiretapping

events.event: Komdigi Secretary General Ismail said the government will set ethical boundaries and a sandbox-style approach for AI rather than conventional prohibitions and sanctions.
events.key_numbers: Statement at CNBC Indonesia Coffee Morning, 3 Nov 2026 · no figures
events.why_it_matters: Signals Indonesia will go light on AI rules, so deepfake and scam victims rely on existing laws like the KUHP.

events.event: ChatGPT's consumer product lead said ChatGPT weekly users rose from 1 billion to 1.2 billion in about 60 days and its search-like queries equal roughly 20% of Google's volume.
events.key_numbers: 1.2 billion weekly users (from 1 billion in about 60 days) · search queries about 20% of Google · 1.5 billion images per week · voice mode 250 million weekly users · Bing about 5% share
events.why_it_matters: Where Indonesians search and get answers is shifting from Google to chatbots, though the figures are company claims.
